aggregateDetail.isnull: isnull(expr) — true where the value is null (use in `where`)
aggregateDetail.notnull: notnull(expr) — true where the value is not null (use in `where`)
aggregateDetail.fill: fill(value expr) — replace nulls: `0 fill price`
aggregateDetail.quantile: <q> quantile <expr> — the q-th quantile; a scalar on a list, like any reducer

keywordDetail.where: row filter predicate(s), comma-separated = AND; <xs> where <pred> filters a list by its own elements; where <bs> (prefix) gives the indices of the true values
keywordDetail.order: sort the result — followed by <col> asc|desc, ...
keywordDetail.asc: ascending sort direction; on a plain list, asc <xs> sorts it ascending
keywordDetail.desc: descending sort direction; on a plain list, desc <xs> sorts it descending
keywordDetail.distinct: distinct <table> — deduplicate rows; distinct <col> — count of distinct values (same as n_unique); distinct <xs> — a list's unique elements, first-seen order
keywordDetail.dropnull: `cols dropnull <table> — drop rows with a null in any of the columns; dropnull <xs> — drop the nulls from a list
keywordDetail.limit: <n> limit <table> — limit the number of returned rows (same as n#table); <n> limit <xs> — the first/last n elements of a list (same as n#xs); on a single string, characters instead of elements
keywordDetail.drop: `col drop <table> — drop named columns; <n> drop <xs> — drop the first/last n elements of a list (same as n _ xs)
keywordDetail.load: load <path> — read a table from disk
keywordDetail.sink: sink <table> <path> — write a table to disk
keywordDetail.lazy: bind a lazy query plan instead of a materialised table
keywordDetail.collect: collect a lazy plan into a table
keywordDetail.like: <str/sym> like <pattern> — q-glob match (* any sequence, ? one char, [..] a class)
keywordDetail.dispatch: <conn> dispatch <stmt> — send a statement to a connection, block for the reply (`ipc` feature)
keywordDetail.async: <conn> async dispatch <stmt> — like dispatch, but returns immediately (`ipc` feature)
keywordDetail.hopen: hopen <port | "host:port"> — open a read-only IPC connection; `w!hopen` opens a write handle (`ipc` feature)
keywordDetail.await: await <pending> — resolve an `async dispatch` reply (`ipc` feature)
keywordDetail.\\port: \port <n> — start serving on port n; bare \port stops (`ipc` feature, REPL only)
keywordDetail.\\i: \i "<path>" — run a script, namespacing its new tables/globals/functions under `.<file-stem>.*`
keywordDetail.enlist: enlist <atom> — the one-element list of a value (`enlist 23` is an int vector, `enlist "a"` a string vector)
keywordDetail.zip: zip `k1`k2!v1 v2 — build a table from a dict of named lists
keywordDetail.while: while[test; s1; s2; ...] — run the statements in order, in the current scope, while the boolean test holds. Yields noop
keywordDetail.noop: noop — evaluates to nothing: prints nothing, and cannot be assigned or used as a value

stdlibDetail..std.str.slice: .std.str.slice[s; start; end] — characters start..end (exclusive), negative indices count from the end
stdlibDetail..std.str.split: .std.str.split[s; sep] — a single string split into a string list
stdlibDetail..std.str.replace: .std.str.replace[s; a; b] — every literal occurrence of a replaced with b
stdlibDetail..std.str.find: .std.str.find[s; p] — character index of the first match, or -1
stdlibDetail..std.arr.has: .std.arr.has[xs; x] — whether x is in xs
stdlibDetail..std.arr.find: .std.arr.find[xs; x] — first index of x, or -1
stdlibDetail..std.arr.rotate: .std.arr.rotate[xs; n] — rotated left by n (right if negative)
stdlibDetail..std.arr.cat: .std.arr.cat[xs; ys] — ys appended to xs; both must be the same list kind
stdlibDetail..std.fs.mkdir: .std.fs.mkdir[p] — create a directory (and its parents); write
stdlibDetail..std.fs.isdir: .std.fs.isdir[p] — whether the path is a directory; iread
stdlibDetail..std.fs.isfile: .std.fs.isfile[p] — whether the path is a file; iread
stdlibDetail..std.fs.mtime: .std.fs.mtime[p] — last modified time, as a timestamp; iread
stdlibDetail..std.fs.name: .std.fs.name[p] — lexical final path component; read
stdlibDetail..std.fs.ext: .std.fs.ext[p] — lexical extension without the dot, or ""; read
stdlibDetail..std.fs.cwd: .std.fs.cwd — the current working directory; iread, no arguments
stdlibDetail..std.fs.rm: .std.fs.rm[p] — remove a file or empty directory, never recursive; write
stdlibDetail..std.env.r: .std.env.r[k] — the overlay then the environment, or "" when unset; iread
stdlibDetail..std.env.s: .std.env.s[k; v] — set k in the overlay only, never the real environment; write
stdlibDetail..std.env.has: .std.env.has[k] — whether k is set in the overlay or environment; iread
stdlibDetail..std.env.all: .std.env.all — a table of every name/value, overlay entries winning; iread, no arguments
